name: Kawanaka Kumi
source: One of the Terrible Trio. Kumi-chan is the least intrusive of the three. She is a happy-go-lucky, absolutely adorable girl with a good head on her shoulders, though she tends to act and dress somewhat childish. She knows exactly how to use her cuteness to her advantage as well, but never in a truly selfish way.
